newsitem.title: USA: Service Merchandise to exit PC business.
newsitem.headline: Service Merchandise to exit PC business.

text.p: Service Merchandise Co Inc said Friday it plans to exit the personal computer business from May 4 to focus on its competitive strengths.

"The combination of relevance to the customer, the enormously competitive market and the slim margins we see from personal computers all contribute to the view that we are better off expanding our offerings of merchandise in which we have demonstrated strong competitiveness," a company statement said.
Service Merchandise offers jewelry and home products and operates 400 stores in 36 states.
